classes.name: IGESSolid_TopoBuilder
classes.summary: This class manages the creation of an IGES Topologic entity (BREP : ManifoldSolid, Shell, Face) This includes definiting of Vertex and Edge Lists, building of Edges and Loops.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an empty TopoBuilder This creates also a unique VertexList and a unique EdgeList, empty, but which can be referenced from starting.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Resets the TopoBuilder for an entirely new operation (with a new EdgeList, a new VertexList, new Shells, ...).

instanceMethods.name: AddVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a Vertex to the VertexList.

instanceMethods.name: NbVertices
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the count of already recorded Vertices.

instanceMethods.name: Vertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Vertex, given its rank.

instanceMethods.name: VertexList
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the VertexList. It can be referenced, but it remains empty until call to EndShell or EndSolid.

instanceMethods.name: AddEdge
instanceMethods.signature: (curve: IGESData_IGESEntity, vstart: number, vend: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an Edge (3D) to the EdgeList, defined by a Curve and two number of Vertex, for start and end.

instanceMethods.name: NbEdges
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the count of recorded Edges (3D).

instanceMethods.name: Edge
instanceMethods.signature: (num: number, vstart: number, vend: number): { curve: IGESData_IGESEntity; vstart: number; vend: number; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.returnType: { curve: IGESData_IGESEntity; vstart: number; vend: number; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the definition of an Edge (3D) given its rank.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `curve`: owned by the returned envelope.
- `vstart`: updated value from the call.
- `vend`: updated value from the call.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: EdgeList
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the EdgeList. It can be referenced, but it remains empty until call to EndShell or EndSolid.

instanceMethods.name: MakeLoop
instanceMethods.comment: Begins the definition of a new Loop : it is the Current Loop All Edges (UV) defined by MakeEdge/EndEdge will be added in it The Loop can then be referenced but is empty. It will be filled with its Edges(UV) by EndLoop (from SetOuter/AddInner).

instanceMethods.name: MakeEdge
instanceMethods.signature: (edgetype: number, edge3d: number, orientation: number): void
instanceMethods.comment:
Defines an Edge(UV), to be added in the current Loop by EndEdge <edgetype> gives the type of the edge <edge3d> identifies the Edge(3D) used as support The EdgeList is always the current one <orientation gives the orientation flag It is then necessary to :
- give the parametric curves
- close the definition of this edge(UV) by EndEdge, else the next call to MakeEdge will erase this one

instanceMethods.name: AddCurveUV
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a Parametric Curve (UV) to the current Edge(UV).

instanceMethods.name: EndEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Closes the definition of an Edge(UV) and adds it to the current Loop.

instanceMethods.name: MakeFace
instanceMethods.comment: Begins the definition of a new Face, on a surface All Loops defined by MakeLoop will be added in it, according the closing call : SetOuter for the Outer Loop (by default, if SetOuter is not called, no OuterLoop is defined); AddInner for the list of Inner Loops (there can be none).

instanceMethods.name: SetOuter
instanceMethods.comment: Closes the current Loop and sets it Loop as Outer Loop. If no current Loop has yet been defined, does nothing.

instanceMethods.name: AddInner

instanceMethods.name: EndFace

instanceMethods.name: MakeShell

instanceMethods.name: EndSimpleShell

instanceMethods.name: EndSolid
